workload.sources: default warm pool; disposable durable snapshot without a warm target
workload.timing: client wall time including transport and operation polling; no latency SLO asserted
workload.classification: aggregate counter deltas per request or batch, never per-child batch miss counts

environment.cache_state: existing warm default pool; sequential snapshot samples populate cache before batches; no cache reset

guest_image_observation.method: Post-run read-only SSH sha256sum on both workers; no rollout or guest changes during run
